digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) management and indexing
propositions: 91 ADR files contain 69 distinct numbers with 17 duplicate-number collisions across 22 files, where only earliest-landed ADRs retain their original numbers and the 22 colliding ADRs are renumbered to 0070-0091

ADR-number collisions are prevented race-free via per-number marker files docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN (content = filename) that produce git add/add conflicts on collision, rather than by CI checks which remain racy

Stranded cross-references to moved ADRs are resolved by slug-based disambiguation and rewritten to their new 0070-0091 numbers, with resolution tier (slug-exact, topic-matched, ancestry, UNRESOLVED) recorded in RENUMBERING.md

CI gate scripts/check_adr_numbers.py enforces ADR-marker bijection, unique markers, and referential integrity for all adr/NNNN-slug links in docs/ and intra-adr cross-links, exiting non-zero on dangling or duplicate references
Generated docs/adr/README.md index groups ADRs by workstream with full slugs, and docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md records old-to-new mapping and per-reference resolution table
Moved ADRs carry a previously-numbered header and kept ADRs carry an ambiguity-window note to document the collision-resolution window
